scope: Bounded source requirements1.1–1.4; eight1.1 authored-teaching requirements complete, other26 requirements remain partial.
identifierPolicy: Requirement suffixes r1, r2, etc. are local editorial audit identifiers; only the parent reference is publisher-numbered.

parents.scopeNote: Eight source clauses have explanations and independently authored worked/unfamiliar exercises; no active exam family or learner trials claimed.

requirements.summary: Relate nutrition to obtaining materials and energy.
Distinguish cellular respiration from breathing.
Relate excretion to metabolic waste rather than undigested food.
Explain responses to changes in surroundings.
Recognise movement without assuming locomotion.
Explain control of internal conditions.
Recognise reproduction as a shared life characteristic.
Recognise growth and development.
